spanish: Y el sacerdote, el ungido, debajo de él desde sus hijos hará a ella; estatuto de siempre a Jehová; entera será hecha humear.

findings.issue: entera is feminine so it agrees with the 3fs hophal verb; the adjective token is masculine singular. The sense whole is kept; the gender is Spanish agreement smoothing.

notes: Each token is represented; hophal stays passive-causative and Jehová is the proper name.
